title: Early Maladaptive Schemas in French Health Care Professionals With Burn Out
official: Early Maladaptive Patterns as Markers of Vulnerability and Targets for Therapeutic Intervention in Burned-out Healthcare Professionals
summary: The purpose of this study is to compare the profiles and domains of maladaptive early schemas in care professionals with burnout symptoms with care professionals without burnout symptoms and with care non-professionals with burnout symptoms.
sponsor: GCS Ramsay Santé pour l'Enseignement et la Recherche
